ko.title: BRICS 정상들 뉴델리 집결, 관세 긴장 속 중동 자제 및 개방 무역 촉구

segments.src: Leaders of the BRICS bloc convened in New Delhi this week for the group's 18th annual summit, with host Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin and counterparts from across the expanding coalition.
segments.tr: BRICS 블록 정상들이 이번 주 뉴델리에 모여 제18차 연례 정상회의를 개최했으며, 주최국인 나렌드라 모디 인도 총리는 시진핑 중국 국가주석, 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령을 비롯해 확장 중인 연합체 전역의 정상들을 맞이했습니다.

segments.src: The gathering produced a joint declaration urging restraint amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East and calling for global trade to remain "open and unimpeded" — language widely read as a response to recent tariff measures out of Washington.
segments.tr: 이번 회동에서는 지속되는 중동 긴장 속에서 자제를 촉구하고 글로벌 무역이 "개방적이고 방해받지 않는" 상태를 유지해야 한다고 요구하는 공동 선언문이 도출되었습니다. 이는 최근 워싱턴에서 나온 관세 조치에 대한 대응으로 널리 해석되는 문구입니다.

segments.src: ## A Joint Message on Trade and Security
segments.tr: ## 무역 및 안보에 관한 공동 메시지

segments.src: According to the declaration issued at the close of the summit, member states expressed concern over the humanitarian toll of conflicts in the Middle East and called on all parties to prioritize dialogue over escalation.
segments.tr: 정상회의 폐막 시 발표된 선언문에 따르면, 회원국들은 중동 분쟁의 인도적 피해에 대해 우려를 표명하고 모든 당사국이 갈등 고조 대신 대화를 우선시할 것을 촉구했습니다.

segments.src: The statement did not single out any one country or faction, instead framing the appeal in broad terms consistent with previous BRICS communiqués on regional conflicts.
segments.tr: 이 성명은 특정 국가나 정파를 지목하지 않고, 대신 지역 분쟁에 대한 이전 BRICS 공동 성명과 일치하는 광범위한 표현으로 호소를 구성했습니다.

segments.src: On trade, the bloc reiterated long-standing objections to unilateral tariff actions and non-tariff barriers, arguing that such measures disrupt supply chains and disproportionately affect developing economies.
segments.tr: 무역과 관련하여, 블록은 일방적인 관세 조치와 비관세 장벽에 대한 오랜 반대 입장을 재확인하며, 이러한 조치가 공급망을 교란하고 개발도상국에 불균형적인 영향을 미친다고 주장했습니다.

segments.src: While the declaration avoided naming the United States directly, the timing and phrasing closely track months of friction between Washington and several BRICS members over import duties and industrial policy.
segments.tr: 선언문에서 미국을 직접적으로 언급하는 것은 피했지만, 그 타이밍과 어조는 수입 관세 및 산업 정책을 둘러싸고 워싱턴과 여러 BRICS 회원국 간에 수개월 동안 이어진 마찰과 밀접하게 맞닿아 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why New Delhi, Why Now
segments.tr: ## 왜 뉴델리인가, 왜 지금인가

segments.src: India's turn as summit host carries symbolic weight.
segments.tr: 인도가 정상회의 개최국을 맡은 것은 상징적인 무게감을 지닙니다.

segments.src: New Delhi has sought to position itself as a bridge-builder within BRICS — maintaining close economic ties with Western partners while also deepening cooperation with Russia and China through the bloc.
segments.tr: 뉴델리는 서방 파트너들과 긴밀한 경제적 유대를 유지하는 동시에 블록을 통해 러시아 및 중국과의 협력도 심화하면서, BRICS 내에서 가교 역할을 자처해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Officials familiar with the discussions said Modi used his position as chair to steer the group toward consensus language rather than more pointed criticism favored by some members, a balancing act that has defined India's BRICS diplomacy in recent years.
segments.tr: 논의에 정통한 관계자들은 모디 총리가 의장으로서의 지위를 활용해 일부 회원국이 선호하는 더 날카로운 비판보다는 합의된 문구로 그룹을 이끌었다고 전했습니다. 이는 최근 몇 년 동안 인도의 BRICS 외교를 정의해 온 균형 잡기 행동입니다.

segments.src: The summit also comes as BRICS continues to grow beyond its founding five members — Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa — having added several new participants in recent expansion rounds.
segments.tr: 이번 정상회의는 또한 BRICS가 창립 5개국인 브라질, 러시아, 인도, 중국, 남아프리카공화국을 넘어 최근의 확장 과정을 통해 여러 새로운 참여국을 추가하며 계속 성장하는 가운데 개최되었습니다.

segments.src: That growth has made reaching unified statements more complex, analysts say, since member states often hold divergent views on specific geopolitical flashpoints even when they can agree on general principles.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 이러한 성장이 통일된 성명에 도달하는 것을 더 복잡하게 만들었다고 말합니다. 회원국들이 일반적인 원칙에는 동의할 수 있더라도 특정 지정학적 화약고에 대해서는 종종 이견을 보이기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## Limited but Notable Unity
segments.tr: ## 제한적이지만 주목할 만한 단결

segments.src: Foreign policy watchers cautioned against reading too much into the joint declaration's real-world impact.
segments.tr: 외교 정책 관측통들은 공동 선언문의 실질적인 영향력에 대해 지나친 의미 부여를 경계했습니다.

segments.src: BRICS communiqués are consensus documents without enforcement mechanisms, and individual members retain sharply different bilateral relationships with Washington, ranging from strategic partnership to open friction.
segments.tr: BRICS 공동 성명은 강제력이 없는 합의 문서이며, 개별 회원국들은 전략적 동반자 관계부터 공개적인 마찰에 이르기까지 워싱턴과 현저히 다른 양자 관계를 유지하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Still, the fact that all attending leaders signed on to shared language on both the Middle East and trade was described by several delegations as a meaningful signal of the bloc's cohesion heading into a period of heightened global economic uncertainty.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고, 참석한 모든 정상들이 중동과 무역 모두에 대해 공유된 문구에 서명했다는 사실은 글로벌 경제 불확실성이 고조되는 시기로 접어드는 상황에서 블록의 결속력을 보여주는 의미 있는 신호라고 여러 대표단은 설명했습니다.

segments.src: Discussions on the summit sidelines reportedly touched on expanding use of local currencies in trade settlement among member states, continued development financing through the New Development Bank, and coordination ahead of upcoming G20 and United Nations gatherings.
segments.tr: 정상회의 외곽에서 진행된 논의에서는 회원국 간 무역 결제 시 현지 통화 사용 확대, 신개발은행(NDB)을 통한 지속적인 개발 금융 지원, 다가오는 G20 및 유엔 회의를 앞둔 공조 등이 다뤄진 것으로 알려졌습니다.

segments.src: No binding agreements on tariffs or sanctions were announced.
segments.tr: 관세나 제재에 관한 구속력 있는 합의는 발표되지 않았습니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 향후 전망

segments.src: Attention now turns to how individual capitals translate the New Delhi declaration into policy.
segments.tr: 이제 관심은 개별 국가들이 뉴델리 선언을 어떻게 정책으로 전환할지에 쏠리고 있습니다.

segments.src: Trade officials in several member states are expected to hold follow-up talks in the coming weeks, while diplomats said further statements on the Middle East situation would depend on how the security situation evolves.
segments.tr: 여러 회원국의 무역 관료들은 향후 몇 주 안에 후속 회담을 가질 예정이며, 외교관들은 중동 상황에 대한 추가 성명은 안보 상황이 어떻게 전개되느냐에 달렸다고 말했습니다.

segments.src: The next BRICS summit is expected to be hosted by another member state under the bloc's rotating chairmanship, continuing a pattern of annual meetings that have become a fixture of the global diplomatic calendar.
segments.tr: 차기 BRICS 정상회의는 순번 의장국 제도에 따라 다른 회원국이 개최할 예정이며, 글로벌 외교 일정의 고정 행사로 자리 잡은 연례 회의의 패턴을 이어갈 것입니다.

segments.src: For now, the New Delhi summit stands as an illustration of BRICS' evolving role: less a unified bloc with a single foreign policy than a forum where major and emerging economies attempt to find common ground on trade fairness and regional stability, even as their individual interests and alliances continue to diverge.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 뉴델리 정상회의가 BRICS의 진화하는 역할을 보여주는 사례로 남아 있습니다. 단일한 외교 정책을 가진 통일된 블록이라기보다는, 개별적인 이해관계와 동맹이 계속 갈라지더라도 주요국과 신흥 경제국들이 무역 공정성과 지역 안정에 대한 공통 분모를 찾고자 시도하는 포럼에 가깝습니다.

zh.title: 金砖国家领导人齐聚新德里，在关税紧张局势下呼吁中东保持克制并开放贸易

segments.src: Leaders of the BRICS bloc convened in New Delhi this week for the group's 18th annual summit, with host Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin and counterparts from across the expanding coalition.
segments.tr: 本周，金砖国家领导人齐聚新德里，参加该组织第18届年度峰会。东道主印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪（Narendra Modi）欢迎了中国国家主席习近平、俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京（Vladimir Putin）以及来自这一不断扩大的联盟的其他国家领导人。

segments.src: The gathering produced a joint declaration urging restraint amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East and calling for global trade to remain "open and unimpeded" — language widely read as a response to recent tariff measures out of Washington.
segments.tr: 此次峰会发表了一份联合声明，敦促在当前中东紧张局势下保持克制，并呼吁全球贸易保持“开放和畅通”——这一措辞被广泛解读为对华盛顿近期关税措施的回应。

segments.src: ## A Joint Message on Trade and Security
segments.tr: ## 关于贸易与安全的共同信息

segments.src: According to the declaration issued at the close of the summit, member states expressed concern over the humanitarian toll of conflicts in the Middle East and called on all parties to prioritize dialogue over escalation.
segments.tr: 根据峰会闭幕时发表的声明，成员国对中东冲突造成的人道主义代价表示关切，并呼吁各方优先考虑对话而非升级局势。

segments.src: The statement did not single out any one country or faction, instead framing the appeal in broad terms consistent with previous BRICS communiqués on regional conflicts.
segments.tr: 声明没有点名任何特定国家或派系，而是以符合金砖国家以往关于地区冲突公报的一贯立场，用宽泛的措辞表达了这一呼吁。

segments.src: On trade, the bloc reiterated long-standing objections to unilateral tariff actions and non-tariff barriers, arguing that such measures disrupt supply chains and disproportionately affect developing economies.
segments.tr: 在贸易方面，该集团重申了对单边关税行动和非关税壁垒的长期反对立场，认为此类措施会扰乱供应链，并对发展中经济体造成不成比例的影响。

segments.src: While the declaration avoided naming the United States directly, the timing and phrasing closely track months of friction between Washington and several BRICS members over import duties and industrial policy.
segments.tr: 虽然声明避免直接点名美国，但其发布的时间和措辞与华盛顿和几个金砖国家成员之间因进口关税和产业政策而持续数月的摩擦密切相关。

segments.src: ## Why New Delhi, Why Now
segments.tr: ## 为什么是新德里，为什么是现在

segments.src: India's turn as summit host carries symbolic weight.
segments.tr: 印度作为峰会东道主具有象征意义。

segments.src: New Delhi has sought to position itself as a bridge-builder within BRICS — maintaining close economic ties with Western partners while also deepening cooperation with Russia and China through the bloc.
segments.tr: 新德里一直试图将自己定位为金砖国家内部的桥梁建设者——在与西方伙伴保持密切经济联系的同时，也通过该集团深化与俄罗斯和中国的合作。

segments.src: Officials familiar with the discussions said Modi used his position as chair to steer the group toward consensus language rather than more pointed criticism favored by some members, a balancing act that has defined India's BRICS diplomacy in recent years.
segments.tr: 熟悉讨论情况的官员表示，莫迪利用其担任主席的职位，引导该组织达成共识，而不是采取一些成员国所倾向的更尖锐的批评，这种平衡行为定义了印度近年来在金砖国家的外交政策。

segments.src: The summit also comes as BRICS continues to grow beyond its founding five members — Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa — having added several new participants in recent expansion rounds.
segments.tr: 此次峰会召开之际，金砖国家正继续超越其创始的五个成员国——巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非——在近期的多轮扩张中增加了几个新成员。

segments.src: That growth has made reaching unified statements more complex, analysts say, since member states often hold divergent views on specific geopolitical flashpoints even when they can agree on general principles.
segments.tr: 分析人士称，这种增长使得达成统一声明变得更加复杂，因为成员国即使在基本原则上能够达成一致，也往往在具体的全球地缘政治热点问题上持有不同观点。

segments.src: ## Limited but Notable Unity
segments.tr: ## 有限但显著的团结

segments.src: Foreign policy watchers cautioned against reading too much into the joint declaration's real-world impact.
segments.tr: 外交政策观察家提醒不要过度解读联合声明的实际影响。

segments.src: BRICS communiqués are consensus documents without enforcement mechanisms, and individual members retain sharply different bilateral relationships with Washington, ranging from strategic partnership to open friction.
segments.tr: 金砖国家公报是缺乏执行机制的共识文件，且各成员国与华盛顿的双边关系截然不同，从战略伙伴关系到公开摩擦不等。

segments.src: Still, the fact that all attending leaders signed on to shared language on both the Middle East and trade was described by several delegations as a meaningful signal of the bloc's cohesion heading into a period of heightened global economic uncertainty.
segments.tr: 尽管如此，所有与会领导人都在中东和贸易问题上签署了共同措辞，这被多个代表团描述为该集团在进入全球经济不确定性加剧时期时，凝聚力的一个有意义的信号。

segments.src: Discussions on the summit sidelines reportedly touched on expanding use of local currencies in trade settlement among member states, continued development financing through the New Development Bank, and coordination ahead of upcoming G20 and United Nations gatherings.
segments.tr: 据报道，峰会间隙的讨论涉及扩大成员国之间在贸易结算中使用本币、通过新开发银行继续提供发展融资，以及在即将举行的G20和联合国会议前进行协调。

segments.src: No binding agreements on tariffs or sanctions were announced.
segments.tr: 会议没有宣布任何关于关税或制裁的约束性协议。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: Attention now turns to how individual capitals translate the New Delhi declaration into policy.
segments.tr: 现在的注意力转向各国首都如何将新德里宣言转化为政策。

segments.src: Trade officials in several member states are expected to hold follow-up talks in the coming weeks, while diplomats said further statements on the Middle East situation would depend on how the security situation evolves.
segments.tr: 预计几个成员国的贸易官员将在未来几周内举行后续会谈，而外交官们表示，关于中东局势的进一步声明将取决于安全局势的演变。

segments.src: The next BRICS summit is expected to be hosted by another member state under the bloc's rotating chairmanship, continuing a pattern of annual meetings that have become a fixture of the global diplomatic calendar.
segments.tr: 预计下一届金砖国家峰会将由轮值主席国制度下的另一个成员国主办，延续年度会议的模式，这些会议已成为全球外交日程的固定项目。

segments.src: For now, the New Delhi summit stands as an illustration of BRICS' evolving role: less a unified bloc with a single foreign policy than a forum where major and emerging economies attempt to find common ground on trade fairness and regional stability, even as their individual interests and alliances continue to diverge.
segments.tr: 目前，新德里峰会展示了金砖国家不断演变的角色：它与其说是一个拥有单一外交政策的统一集团，不如说是一个论坛，主要经济体和新兴经济体在这里试图就贸易公平和地区稳定寻找共同点，尽管它们各自的利益和联盟关系仍在不断分化。

hi.title: ब्रिक्स नेता नई दिल्ली में एकत्र हुए, टैरिफ तनाव के बीच मध्य पूर्व में संयम और खुले व्यापार का आह्वान किया

segments.src: Leaders of the BRICS bloc convened in New Delhi this week for the group's 18th annual summit, with host Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin and counterparts from across the expanding coalition.
segments.tr: ब्रिक्स समूह के नेता समूह के 18वें वार्षिक शिखर सम्मेलन के लिए इस सप्ताह नई दिल्ली में एकत्रित हुए, जहाँ मेजबान प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने चीनी राष्ट्रपति शी जिनपिंग, रूसी राष्ट्रपति व्लादिमीर पुतिन और बढ़ते गठबंधन के अन्य समकक्षों का स्वागत किया।

segments.src: The gathering produced a joint declaration urging restraint amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East and calling for global trade to remain "open and unimpeded" — language widely read as a response to recent tariff measures out of Washington.
segments.tr: इस बैठक में एक संयुक्त घोषणा-पत्र जारी किया गया जिसमें मध्य पूर्व में चल रहे तनाव के बीच संयम बरतने का आग्रह किया गया और वैश्विक व्यापार को "खुला और अबाधित" रखने का आह्वान किया गया—इस भाषा को व्यापक रूप से वाशिंगटन के हालिया टैरिफ उपायों के जवाब के रूप में देखा गया।

segments.src: ## A Joint Message on Trade and Security
segments.tr: ## व्यापार और सुरक्षा पर एक संयुक्त संदेश

segments.src: According to the declaration issued at the close of the summit, member states expressed concern over the humanitarian toll of conflicts in the Middle East and called on all parties to prioritize dialogue over escalation.
segments.tr: शिखर सम्मेलन के समापन पर जारी घोषणा-पत्र के अनुसार, सदस्य देशों ने मध्य पूर्व में संघर्षों से होने वाली मानवीय क्षति पर चिंता व्यक्त की और सभी पक्षों से तनाव बढ़ाने के बजाय बातचीत को प्राथमिकता देने का आह्वान किया।

segments.src: The statement did not single out any one country or faction, instead framing the appeal in broad terms consistent with previous BRICS communiqués on regional conflicts.
segments.tr: बयान में किसी एक देश या गुट को विशेष रूप से लक्षित नहीं किया गया, बल्कि क्षेत्रीय संघर्षों पर पिछले ब्रिक्स विज्ञप्तियों के अनुरूप व्यापक शब्दों में अपील को तैयार किया गया।

segments.src: On trade, the bloc reiterated long-standing objections to unilateral tariff actions and non-tariff barriers, arguing that such measures disrupt supply chains and disproportionately affect developing economies.
segments.tr: व्यापार पर, समूह ने एकतरफा टैरिफ कार्रवाइयों और गैर-टैरिफ बाधाओं के खिलाफ अपनी पुरानी आपत्तियों को दोहराया, यह तर्क देते हुए कि ऐसे उपाय आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं को बाधित करते हैं और विकासशील अर्थव्यवस्थाओं को असमान रूप से प्रभावित करते हैं।

segments.src: While the declaration avoided naming the United States directly, the timing and phrasing closely track months of friction between Washington and several BRICS members over import duties and industrial policy.
segments.tr: यद्यपि घोषणा-पत्र में सीधे तौर पर संयुक्त राष्ट्र अमेरिका का नाम लेने से बचा गया, लेकिन इसका समय और शब्दावली वाशिंगटन तथा कई ब्रिक्स सदस्यों के बीच आयात शुल्क और औद्योगिक नीति को लेकर महीनों के तनाव से मेल खाती है।

segments.src: ## Why New Delhi, Why Now
segments.tr: ## नई दिल्ली क्यों, अभी क्यों

segments.src: India's turn as summit host carries symbolic weight.
segments.tr: भारत की शिखर सम्मेलन की मेजबानी का प्रतीकात्मक महत्व है।

segments.src: New Delhi has sought to position itself as a bridge-builder within BRICS — maintaining close economic ties with Western partners while also deepening cooperation with Russia and China through the bloc.
segments.tr: नई दिल्ली ने ब्रिक्स के भीतर एक सेतु निर्माता के रूप में खुद को स्थापित करने की कोशिश की है—पश्चिमी साझेदारों के साथ घनिष्ठ आर्थिक संबंध बनाए रखना और साथ ही समूह के माध्यम से रूस तथा चीन के साथ सहयोग को गहरा करना।

segments.src: Officials familiar with the discussions said Modi used his position as chair to steer the group toward consensus language rather than more pointed criticism favored by some members, a balancing act that has defined India's BRICS diplomacy in recent years.
segments.tr: चर्चा से जुड़े अधिकारियों ने कहा कि मोदी ने कुछ सदस्यों द्वारा पसंद की जाने वाली तीखी आलोचना के बजाय समूह को आम सहमति वाली भाषा की ओर ले जाने के लिए अध्यक्ष के रूप में अपनी स्थिति का उपयोग किया, जो हाल के वर्षों में भारत की ब्रिक्स कूटनीति की विशेषता रही है।

segments.src: The summit also comes as BRICS continues to grow beyond its founding five members — Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa — having added several new participants in recent expansion rounds.
segments.tr: यह शिखर सम्मेलन ऐसे समय में भी हो रहा है जब ब्रिक्स अपने संस्थापक पांच सदस्यों—ब्राजील, रूस, भारत, चीन और दक्षिण अफ्रीका—से आगे बढ़कर विस्तार के हालिया दौर में कई नए प्रतिभागियों को जोड़ रहा है।

segments.src: That growth has made reaching unified statements more complex, analysts say, since member states often hold divergent views on specific geopolitical flashpoints even when they can agree on general principles.
segments.tr: विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि उस वृद्धि ने एकीकृत बयान तक पहुँचना अधिक जटिल बना दिया है, क्योंकि सदस्य देश विशिष्ट भू-राजनीतिक मुद्दों पर अक्सर अलग-अलग विचार रखते हैं, भले ही वे सामान्य सिद्धांतों पर सहमत हों।

segments.src: ## Limited but Notable Unity
segments.tr: ## सीमित लेकिन उल्लेखनीय एकता

segments.src: Foreign policy watchers cautioned against reading too much into the joint declaration's real-world impact.
segments.tr: विदेश नीति पर नजर रखने वालों ने संयुक्त घोषणा-पत्र के वास्तविक दुनिया के प्रभाव के बारे में बहुत अधिक अनुमान लगाने से बचने की चेतावनी दी।

segments.src: BRICS communiqués are consensus documents without enforcement mechanisms, and individual members retain sharply different bilateral relationships with Washington, ranging from strategic partnership to open friction.
segments.tr: ब्रिक्स विज्ञप्तियाँ प्रवर्तन तंत्र के बिना आम सहमति वाले दस्तावेज हैं, और व्यक्तिगत सदस्यों के वाशिंगटन के साथ रणनीतिक साझेदारी से लेकर खुली तनातनी तक, काफी अलग द्विपक्षीय संबंध हैं।

segments.src: Still, the fact that all attending leaders signed on to shared language on both the Middle East and trade was described by several delegations as a meaningful signal of the bloc's cohesion heading into a period of heightened global economic uncertainty.
segments.tr: फिर भी, इस तथ्य को कि भाग लेने वाले सभी नेताओं ने मध्य पूर्व और व्यापार दोनों पर साझा भाषा पर हस्ताक्षर किए, कई प्रतिनिधिमंडलों द्वारा वैश्विक आर्थिक अनिश्चितता के दौर में प्रवेश करने वाले समूह की एकजुटता के एक सार्थक संकेत के रूप में वर्णित किया गया।

segments.src: Discussions on the summit sidelines reportedly touched on expanding use of local currencies in trade settlement among member states, continued development financing through the New Development Bank, and coordination ahead of upcoming G20 and United Nations gatherings.
segments.tr: खबरों के अनुसार शिखर सम्मेलन की बैठकों से इतर सदस्य देशों के बीच व्यापार निपटान में स्थानीय मुद्राओं के बढ़ते उपयोग, न्यू डेवलपमेंट बैंक के माध्यम से निरंतर विकास वित्तपोषण और आगामी जी20 तथा संयुक्त राष्ट्र बैठकों से पहले समन्वय पर चर्चा हुई।

segments.src: No binding agreements on tariffs or sanctions were announced.
segments.tr: टैरिफ या प्रतिबंधों पर कोई बाध्यकारी समझौता घोषित नहीं किया गया।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: Attention now turns to how individual capitals translate the New Delhi declaration into policy.
segments.tr: अब ध्यान इस बात पर केंद्रित है कि व्यक्तिगत राजधानियाँ नई दिल्ली घोषणा-पत्र को नीति में कैसे बदलती हैं।

segments.src: Trade officials in several member states are expected to hold follow-up talks in the coming weeks, while diplomats said further statements on the Middle East situation would depend on how the security situation evolves.
segments.tr: कई सदस्य देशों के व्यापार अधिकारियों के आने वाले हफ्तों में अनुवर्ती वार्ता करने की उम्मीद है, जबकि राजनयिकों ने कहा कि मध्य पूर्व की स्थिति पर आगे के बयान इस बात पर निर्भर करेंगे कि सुरक्षा स्थिति कैसे विकसित होती है।

segments.src: The next BRICS summit is expected to be hosted by another member state under the bloc's rotating chairmanship, continuing a pattern of annual meetings that have become a fixture of the global diplomatic calendar.
segments.tr: अगला ब्रिक्स शिखर सम्मेलन समूह की घूर्णन अध्यक्षता के तहत किसी अन्य सदस्य देश द्वारा आयोजित किए जाने की उम्मीद है, जिससे वार्षिक बैठकों का एक ऐसा सिलसिला जारी रहेगा जो वैश्विक कूटनीतिक कैलेंडर का एक हिस्सा बन गया है।

segments.src: For now, the New Delhi summit stands as an illustration of BRICS' evolving role: less a unified bloc with a single foreign policy than a forum where major and emerging economies attempt to find common ground on trade fairness and regional stability, even as their individual interests and alliances continue to diverge.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, नई दिल्ली शिखर सम्मेलन ब्रिक्स की विकसित होती भूमिका के एक उदाहरण के रूप में खड़ा है: एक एकल विदेश नीति वाले एकीकृत ब्लॉक के रूप में कम, बल्कि एक ऐसे मंच के रूप में जहाँ प्रमुख और उभरती हुई अर्थव्यवस्थाएँ व्यापार निष्पक्षता और क्षेत्रीय स्थिरता पर आम जमीन तलाशने का प्रयास करती हैं, भले ही उनके व्यक्तिगत हित और गठबंधन अलग-अलग बने रहें।

es.title: Los líderes de los BRICS se reúnen en Nueva Delhi y piden moderación en Oriente Medio y comercio abierto en medio de tensiones arancelarias

segments.src: Leaders of the BRICS bloc convened in New Delhi this week for the group's 18th annual summit, with host Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin and counterparts from across the expanding coalition.
segments.tr: Los líderes del bloque BRICS se congregaron en Nueva Delhi esta semana para la 18ª cumbre anual del grupo, con el primer ministro anfitrión, Narendra Modi, dando la bienvenida al presidente chino, Xi Jinping, al presidente ruso, Vladimir Putin, y a sus homólogos de toda la coalición en expansión.

segments.src: The gathering produced a joint declaration urging restraint amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East and calling for global trade to remain "open and unimpeded" — language widely read as a response to recent tariff measures out of Washington.
segments.tr: La reunión produjo una declaración conjunta en la que se insta a la moderación en medio de las tensiones actuales en Oriente Medio y se pide que el comercio mundial permanezca "abierto y sin trabas", un lenguaje ampliamente interpretado como una respuesta a las recientes medidas arancelarias procedentes de Washington.

segments.src: ## A Joint Message on Trade and Security
segments.tr: ## Un mensaje conjunto sobre comercio y seguridad

segments.src: According to the declaration issued at the close of the summit, member states expressed concern over the humanitarian toll of conflicts in the Middle East and called on all parties to prioritize dialogue over escalation.
segments.tr: Según la declaración emitida al cierre de la cumbre, los estados miembros expresaron su preocupación por el costo humanitario de los conflictos en Oriente Medio y pidieron a todas las partes que den prioridad al diálogo por encima de la escalada.

segments.src: The statement did not single out any one country or faction, instead framing the appeal in broad terms consistent with previous BRICS communiqués on regional conflicts.
segments.tr: La declaración no señaló a ningún país o facción en particular, sino que enmarcó el llamamiento en términos amplios coherentes con comunicados anteriores de los BRICS sobre conflictos regionales.

segments.src: On trade, the bloc reiterated long-standing objections to unilateral tariff actions and non-tariff barriers, arguing that such measures disrupt supply chains and disproportionately affect developing economies.
segments.tr: En materia comercial, el bloque reiteró sus objeciones de larga data a las acciones arancelarias unilaterales y a las barreras no arancelarias, argumentando que tales medidas perturban las cadenas de suministro y afectan desproporcionadamente a las economías en desarrollo.

segments.src: While the declaration avoided naming the United States directly, the timing and phrasing closely track months of friction between Washington and several BRICS members over import duties and industrial policy.
segments.tr: Si bien la declaración evitó nombrar directamente a Estados Unidos, el momento y la redacción siguen de cerca meses de fricción entre Washington y varios miembros de los BRICS por los aranceles a la importación y la política industrial.

segments.src: ## Why New Delhi, Why Now
segments.tr: ## Por qué Nueva Delhi, por qué ahora

segments.src: India's turn as summit host carries symbolic weight.
segments.tr: El turno de la India como anfitriona de la cumbre tiene un peso simbólico.

segments.src: New Delhi has sought to position itself as a bridge-builder within BRICS — maintaining close economic ties with Western partners while also deepening cooperation with Russia and China through the bloc.
segments.tr: Nueva Delhi ha tratado de posicionarse como un constructor de puentes dentro de los BRICS, manteniendo estrechos lazos económicos con socios occidentales al tiempo que profundiza la cooperación con Rusia y China a través del bloque.

segments.src: Officials familiar with the discussions said Modi used his position as chair to steer the group toward consensus language rather than more pointed criticism favored by some members, a balancing act that has defined India's BRICS diplomacy in recent years.
segments.tr: Funcionarios familiarizados con las discusiones dijeron que Modi usó su posición como presidente para orientar al grupo hacia un lenguaje de consenso en lugar de la crítica más aguda favorecida por algunos miembros, un acto de equilibrio que ha definido la diplomacia de los BRICS de la India en los últimos años.

segments.src: The summit also comes as BRICS continues to grow beyond its founding five members — Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa — having added several new participants in recent expansion rounds.
segments.tr: La cumbre también se produce cuando los BRICS continúan creciendo más allá de sus cinco miembros fundadores (Brasil, Rusia, India, China y Sudáfrica), habiendo incorporado a varios nuevos participantes en rondas de expansión recientes.

segments.src: That growth has made reaching unified statements more complex, analysts say, since member states often hold divergent views on specific geopolitical flashpoints even when they can agree on general principles.
segments.tr: Ese crecimiento ha hecho que alcanzar declaraciones unificadas sea más complejo, dicen los analistas, ya que los estados miembros a menudo tienen puntos de vista divergentes sobre puntos críticos geopolíticos específicos, incluso cuando pueden ponerse de acuerdo sobre principios generales.

segments.src: ## Limited but Notable Unity
segments.tr: ## Unidad limitada pero notable

segments.src: Foreign policy watchers cautioned against reading too much into the joint declaration's real-world impact.
segments.tr: Los observadores de la política exterior advirtieron que no se debe dar demasiada importancia al impacto en el mundo real de la declaración conjunta.

segments.src: BRICS communiqués are consensus documents without enforcement mechanisms, and individual members retain sharply different bilateral relationships with Washington, ranging from strategic partnership to open friction.
segments.tr: Los comunicados de los BRICS son documentos de consenso sin mecanismos de cumplimiento, y los miembros individuales mantienen relaciones bilaterales drásticamente diferentes con Washington, que van desde la asociación estratégica hasta la fricción abierta.

segments.src: Still, the fact that all attending leaders signed on to shared language on both the Middle East and trade was described by several delegations as a meaningful signal of the bloc's cohesion heading into a period of heightened global economic uncertainty.
segments.tr: Aun así, el hecho de que todos los líderes asistentes suscribieran un lenguaje compartido tanto sobre Oriente Medio como sobre el comercio fue descrito por varias delegaciones como una señal significativa de la cohesión del bloque de cara a un período de mayor incertidumbre económica mundial.

segments.src: Discussions on the summit sidelines reportedly touched on expanding use of local currencies in trade settlement among member states, continued development financing through the New Development Bank, and coordination ahead of upcoming G20 and United Nations gatherings.
segments.tr: Las discusiones al margen de la cumbre supuestamente abordaron la expansión del uso de monedas locales en la liquidación de comercios entre los estados miembros, el desarrollo continuo de la financiación a través del Nuevo Banco de Desarrollo y la coordinación antes de las próximas reuniones del G20 y las Naciones Unidas.

segments.src: No binding agreements on tariffs or sanctions were announced.
segments.tr: No se anunciaron acuerdos vinculantes sobre aranceles o sanciones.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Qué pasará a continuación

segments.tr: La atención se centra ahora en cómo las capitales individuales traducen la declaración de Nueva Delhi en políticas.

segments.src: Trade officials in several member states are expected to hold follow-up talks in the coming weeks, while diplomats said further statements on the Middle East situation would depend on how the security situation evolves.
segments.tr: Se espera que los funcionarios de comercio de varios estados miembros mantengan conversaciones de seguimiento en las próximas semanas, mientras que los diplomáticos dijeron que las declaraciones adicionales sobre la situación en Oriente Medio dependerían de cómo evolucione la situación de seguridad.

segments.src: The next BRICS summit is expected to be hosted by another member state under the bloc's rotating chairmanship, continuing a pattern of annual meetings that have become a fixture of the global diplomatic calendar.
segments.tr: Se espera que la próxima cumbre de los BRICS sea organizada por otro estado miembro bajo la presidencia rotativa del bloque, continuando un patrón de reuniones anuales que se han convertido en un elemento fijo del calendario diplomático mundial.

segments.src: For now, the New Delhi summit stands as an illustration of BRICS' evolving role: less a unified bloc with a single foreign policy than a forum where major and emerging economies attempt to find common ground on trade fairness and regional stability, even as their individual interests and alliances continue to diverge.
segments.tr: Por ahora, la cumbre de Nueva Delhi se erige como una ilustración del papel en evolución de los BRICS: menos un bloque unificado con una sola política exterior que un foro donde las economías grandes y emergentes intentan encontrar puntos en común sobre la equidad comercial y la estabilidad regional, incluso cuando sus intereses y alianzas individuales continúan divergiendo.

segments.src: ## Why New Delhi, Why Now
segments.tr: ## لماذا نيودلهي، ولماذا الآن

segments.src: India's turn as summit host carries symbolic weight.

segments.src: New Delhi has sought to position itself as a bridge-builder within BRICS — maintaining close economic ties with Western partners while also deepening cooperation with Russia and China through the bloc.
segments.tr: سعت نيودلهي إلى وضع نفسها كبناة جسور داخل بريكس - مع الحفاظ على علاقات اقتصادية وثيقة مع الشركاء الغربيين وفي الوقت نفسه تعميق التعاون مع روسيا والصين من خلال الكتلة.

segments.src: Officials familiar with the discussions said Modi used his position as chair to steer the group toward consensus language rather than more pointed criticism favored by some members, a balancing act that has defined India's BRICS diplomacy in recent years.
segments.tr: قال مسؤولون مطلعون على المناقشات إن مودي استخدم منصبه كرئيس لتوجيه المجموعة نحو لغة توافقية بدلاً من الانتقادات الأكثر حدة التي فضلها بعض الأعضاء، وهو عمل توازن حدد دبلوماسية الهند في بريكس في السنوات الأخيرة.

segments.src: The summit also comes as BRICS continues to grow beyond its founding five members — Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa — having added several new participants in recent expansion rounds.
segments.tr: تأتي القمة أيضاً في الوقت الذي تستمر فيه بريكس في النمو خارج أعضائها المؤسسين الخمسة - البرازيل روسيا والهند والصين وجنوب إفريقيا - بعد أن أضافت العديد من المشاركين الجدد في جولات التوسع الأخيرة.

segments.src: That growth has made reaching unified statements more complex, analysts say, since member states often hold divergent views on specific geopolitical flashpoints even when they can agree on general principles.
segments.tr: يقول المحللون إن هذا النمو جعل الوصول إلى بيانات موحدة أكثر تعقيداً، نظراً لأن الدول الأعضاء غالباً ما تحمل وجهات نظر متباينة بشأن نقاط الاشتعال الجوسياسية المحددة حتى عندما تتمكن من الاتفاق على المبادئ العامة.

segments.src: ## Limited but Notable Unity
segments.tr: ## وحدة محدودة ولكنها ملحوظة

segments.tr: حذر مراقبو السياسة الخارجية من قراءة الكثير في التأثير الواقعي للإعلان المشترك.

segments.src: BRICS communiqués are consensus documents without enforcement mechanisms, and individual members retain sharply different bilateral relationships with Washington, ranging from strategic partnership to open friction.

segments.src: Still, the fact that all attending leaders signed on to shared language on both the Middle East and trade was described by several delegations as a meaningful signal of the bloc's cohesion heading into a period of heightened global economic uncertainty.
segments.tr: مع ذلك، تم وصف حقيقة أن جميع القادة الحاضرين وقعوا على لغة مشتركة بشأن كل من الشرق الأوسط والتجارة من قبل عدة وفود كإشارة ذات مغزى على تماسك الكتلة متجهين نحو فترة من عدم اليقين الاقتصادي العالمي المتزايد.

segments.src: Discussions on the summit sidelines reportedly touched on expanding use of local currencies in trade settlement among member states, continued development financing through the New Development Bank, and coordination ahead of upcoming G20 and United Nations gatherings.
segments.tr: أفادت التقارير أن المناقشات على هامش القمة تطرقت إلى توسيع استخدام العملات المحلية في تسوية التجارة بين الدول الأعضاء، واستمرار تمويل التنمية من خلال بنك التنمية الجديد، والتنسيق قبل تجمعات مجموعة العشرين والأمم المتحدة القادمة.

segments.src: No binding agreements on tariffs or sanctions were announced.
segments.tr: لم يتم الإعلان عن أي اتفاقيات ملزمة بشأن الرسوم الجمركية أو العقوبات.

segments.src: For now, the New Delhi summit stands as an illustration of BRICS' evolving role: less a unified bloc with a single foreign policy than a forum where major and emerging economies attempt to find common ground on trade fairness and regional stability, even as their individual interests and alliances continue to diverge.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، تقف قمة نيودلهي كدليل على دور بريكس المتطور: فهي أقل من كتلة موحدة ذات سياسة خارجية واحدة وأكثر من كونها منتدى يحاول فيه الاقتصادات الكبرى والناشئة العثور على أرضية مشتركة بشأن عدالة التجارة والاستقرار الإقليمي، حتى مع استمرار مصالحهما وتحالفاتهما الفردية في التباعد.

fr.title: Les dirigeants des BRICS se réunissent à New Delhi, appellent à la retenue au Moyen-Orient et au libre-échange face aux tensions douanières

segments.src: Leaders of the BRICS bloc convened in New Delhi this week for the group's 18th annual summit, with host Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin and counterparts from across the expanding coalition.
segments.tr: Les dirigeants du bloc des BRICS se sont réunis à New Delhi cette semaine pour le 18e sommet annuel du groupe, le Premier ministre hôte Narendra Modi accueillant le président chinois Xi Jinping, le président russe Vladimir Poutine et leurs homologues de toute la coalition en pleine expansion.

segments.src: The gathering produced a joint declaration urging restraint amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East and calling for global trade to remain "open and unimpeded" — language widely read as a response to recent tariff measures out of Washington.
segments.tr: La rencontre a donné lieu à une déclaration commune exhortant à la retenue face aux tensions en cours au Moyen-Orient et appelant le commerce mondial à rester « ouvert et sans entrave » — une formulation largement interprétée comme une réponse aux récentes mesures tarifaires prises par Washington.

segments.src: ## A Joint Message on Trade and Security
segments.tr: ## Un message conjoint sur le commerce et la sécurité

segments.src: According to the declaration issued at the close of the summit, member states expressed concern over the humanitarian toll of conflicts in the Middle East and called on all parties to prioritize dialogue over escalation.
segments.tr: Selon la déclaration publiée à l'issue du sommet, les États membres ont exprimé leur inquiétude quant au coût humain des conflits au Moyen-Orient et ont appelé toutes les parties à prioriser le dialogue plutôt que l'escalade.

segments.src: The statement did not single out any one country or faction, instead framing the appeal in broad terms consistent with previous BRICS communiqués on regional conflicts.
segments.tr: La déclaration n'a désigné aucun pays ni aucune faction en particulier, cadrant plutôt l'appel en termes généraux conformes aux communiqués précédents des BRICS sur les conflits régionaux.

segments.src: On trade, the bloc reiterated long-standing objections to unilateral tariff actions and non-tariff barriers, arguing that such measures disrupt supply chains and disproportionately affect developing economies.
segments.tr: Sur le plan commercial, le bloc a réitéré ses objections de longue date aux mesures tarifaires unilatérales et aux barrières non tarifaires, soutenant que de telles mesures perturbent les chaînes d'approvisionnement et affectent de manière disproportionnée les économies en développement.

segments.src: While the declaration avoided naming the United States directly, the timing and phrasing closely track months of friction between Washington and several BRICS members over import duties and industrial policy.
segments.tr: Bien que la déclaration ait évité de nommer directement les États-Unis, le calendrier et la formulation suivent de près des mois de frictions entre Washington et plusieurs membres des BRICS concernant les droits de douane à l'importation et la politique industrielle.

segments.src: ## Why New Delhi, Why Now
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi New Delhi, pourquoi maintenant

segments.src: India's turn as summit host carries symbolic weight.
segments.tr: Le tour de l'Inde en tant qu'hôte du sommet revêt un poids symbolique.

segments.src: New Delhi has sought to position itself as a bridge-builder within BRICS — maintaining close economic ties with Western partners while also deepening cooperation with Russia and China through the bloc.
segments.tr: New Delhi a cherché à se positionner comme un bâtisseur de ponts au sein des BRICS — en maintenant des liens économiques étroits avec ses partenaires occidentaux tout en approfondissant la coopération avec la Russie et la Chine par l'intermédiaire du bloc.

segments.src: Officials familiar with the discussions said Modi used his position as chair to steer the group toward consensus language rather than more pointed criticism favored by some members, a balancing act that has defined India's BRICS diplomacy in recent years.
segments.tr: Des responsables au fait des discussions ont déclaré que Modi avait utilisé sa position de président pour orienter le groupe vers un langage de consensus plutôt que vers les critiques plus directes privilégiées par certains membres, un acte d'équilibrisme qui a défini la diplomatie indienne au sein des BRICS ces dernières années.

segments.src: The summit also comes as BRICS continues to grow beyond its founding five members — Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa — having added several new participants in recent expansion rounds.
segments.tr: Le sommet intervient également alors que les BRICS continuent de s'agrandir au-delà de leurs cinq membres fondateurs — le Brésil, la Russie, l'Inde, la Chine et l'Afrique du Sud — ayant ajouté plusieurs nouveaux participants lors des récents cycles d'élargissement.

segments.src: That growth has made reaching unified statements more complex, analysts say, since member states often hold divergent views on specific geopolitical flashpoints even when they can agree on general principles.
segments.tr: Cette croissance a rendu l'obtention de déclarations unifiées plus complexe, selon les analystes, car les États membres ont souvent des points de vue divergents sur des points chauds géopolitiques spécifiques, même lorsqu'ils s'accordent sur des principes généraux.

segments.src: ## Limited but Notable Unity
segments.tr: ## Une unité limitée mais remarquable

segments.src: Foreign policy watchers cautioned against reading too much into the joint declaration's real-world impact.
segments.tr: Les observateurs de la politique étrangère ont mis en garde contre une surinterprétation de l'impact réel de la déclaration commune.

segments.src: BRICS communiqués are consensus documents without enforcement mechanisms, and individual members retain sharply different bilateral relationships with Washington, ranging from strategic partnership to open friction.
segments.tr: Les communiqués des BRICS sont des documents de consensus sans mécanismes d'application, et les membres individuels conservent des relations bilatérales très différentes avec Washington, allant du partenariat stratégique à la friction ouverte.

segments.src: Still, the fact that all attending leaders signed on to shared language on both the Middle East and trade was described by several delegations as a meaningful signal of the bloc's cohesion heading into a period of heightened global economic uncertainty.
segments.tr: Néanmoins, le fait que tous les dirigeants présents aient signé un langage partagé sur le Moyen-Orient et le commerce a été décrit par plusieurs délégations comme un signal significatif de la cohésion du bloc à l'approche d'une période d'incertitude économique mondiale accrue.

segments.src: Discussions on the summit sidelines reportedly touched on expanding use of local currencies in trade settlement among member states, continued development financing through the New Development Bank, and coordination ahead of upcoming G20 and United Nations gatherings.
segments.tr: Les discussions en marge du sommet auraient abordé l'utilisation accrue des monnaies locales dans le règlement des échanges commerciaux entre les États membres, le financement continu du développement par l'intermédiaire de la Nouvelle banque de développement, et la coordination avant les réunions à venir du G20 et des Nations Unies.

segments.src: No binding agreements on tariffs or sanctions were announced.
segments.tr: Aucun accord contraignant sur les tarifs ou les sanctions n'a été annoncé.

segments.tr: ## Et maintenant ?

segments.src: Attention now turns to how individual capitals translate the New Delhi declaration into policy.
segments.tr: L'attention se porte désormais sur la manière dont les différentes capitales vont traduire la déclaration de New Delhi dans leurs politiques.

segments.src: Trade officials in several member states are expected to hold follow-up talks in the coming weeks, while diplomats said further statements on the Middle East situation would depend on how the security situation evolves.
segments.tr: Les responsables du commerce de plusieurs États membres devraient tenir des discussions de suivi dans les semaines à venir, tandis que les diplomates ont déclaré que de nouvelles déclarations sur la situation au Moyen-Orient dépendraient de l'évolution de la situation sécuritaire.

segments.src: The next BRICS summit is expected to be hosted by another member state under the bloc's rotating chairmanship, continuing a pattern of annual meetings that have become a fixture of the global diplomatic calendar.
segments.tr: Le prochain sommet des BRICS devrait être accueilli par un autre État membre dans le cadre de la présidence tournante du bloc, poursuivant le modèle de réunions annuelles devenues un rendez-vous fixe du calendrier diplomatique mondial.

segments.src: For now, the New Delhi summit stands as an illustration of BRICS' evolving role: less a unified bloc with a single foreign policy than a forum where major and emerging economies attempt to find common ground on trade fairness and regional stability, even as their individual interests and alliances continue to diverge.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, le sommet de New Delhi illustre le rôle évolutif des BRICS : moins un bloc unifié doté d'une politique étrangère unique qu'un forum où des économies majeures et émergentes tentent de trouver un terrain d'entente sur l'équité commerciale et la stabilité régionale, alors même que leurs intérêts et alliances individuels continuent de diverger.
