segments.tr: ## Pesan Bersama tentang Perdagangan dan Keamanan

segments.src: According to the declaration issued at the close of the summit, member states expressed concern over the humanitarian toll of conflicts in the Middle East and called on all parties to prioritize dialogue over escalation.
segments.tr: Menurut deklarasi yang dikeluarkan pada penutupan KTT, negara-negara anggota menyatakan keprihatinan atas dampak kemanusiaan dari konflik di Timur Tengah dan meminta semua pihak untuk memprioritaskan dialog daripada eskalasi.

segments.src: The statement did not single out any one country or faction, instead framing the appeal in broad terms consistent with previous BRICS communiqués on regional conflicts.
segments.tr: Pernyataan tersebut tidak menyebutkan satu negara atau faksi tertentu, melainkan membingkai seruan tersebut dalam istilah luas yang konsisten dengan komunike BRICS sebelumnya mengenai konflik regional.

segments.src: On trade, the bloc reiterated long-standing objections to unilateral tariff actions and non-tariff barriers, arguing that such measures disrupt supply chains and disproportionately affect developing economies.
segments.tr: Mengenai perdagangan, blok tersebut menegaskan kembali keberatan lama terhadap tindakan tarif sepihak dan hambatan non-tarif, dengan alasan bahwa langkah-langkah tersebut mengganggu rantai pasokan dan secara tidak proporsional memengaruhi ekonomi berkembang.

segments.src: While the declaration avoided naming the United States directly, the timing and phrasing closely track months of friction between Washington and several BRICS members over import duties and industrial policy.
segments.tr: Meskipun deklarasi tersebut menghindari penyebutan Amerika Serikat secara langsung, waktu dan bahasanya sangat mengikuti gesekan selama berbulan-bulan antara Washington dan beberapa anggota BRICS mengenai bea masuk dan kebijakan industri.

segments.src: ## Why New Delhi, Why Now
segments.tr: ## Mengapa New Delhi, Mengapa Sekarang

segments.src: India's turn as summit host carries symbolic weight.
segments.tr: Giliran India sebagai tuan rumah KTT memiliki bobot simbolis.

segments.src: New Delhi has sought to position itself as a bridge-builder within BRICS — maintaining close economic ties with Western partners while also deepening cooperation with Russia and China through the bloc.
segments.tr: New Delhi telah berusaha memposisikan dirinya sebagai pembangun jembatan di dalam BRICS — mempertahankan hubungan ekonomi yang erat dengan mitra Barat sambil juga memperdalam kerja sama dengan Rusia dan Tiongkok melalui blok tersebut.

segments.src: Officials familiar with the discussions said Modi used his position as chair to steer the group toward consensus language rather than more pointed criticism favored by some members, a balancing act that has defined India's BRICS diplomacy in recent years.
segments.tr: Para pejabat yang mengetahui diskusi tersebut mengatakan Modi menggunakan posisinya sebagai ketua untuk mengarahkan kelompok tersebut menuju bahasa konsensus daripada kritik yang lebih tajam yang disukai oleh beberapa anggota, sebuah tindakan penyeimbang yang telah menentukan diplomasi BRICS India dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: The summit also comes as BRICS continues to grow beyond its founding five members — Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa — having added several new participants in recent expansion rounds.
segments.tr: KTT ini juga terjadi saat BRICS terus tumbuh melampaui lima anggota pendirinya — Brasil, Rusia, India, Tiongkok, dan Afrika Selatan — setelah menambahkan beberapa peserta baru dalam putaran ekspansi baru-baru ini.

segments.src: That growth has made reaching unified statements more complex, analysts say, since member states often hold divergent views on specific geopolitical flashpoints even when they can agree on general principles.
segments.tr: Pertumbuhan itu membuat pencapaian pernyataan terpadu menjadi lebih kompleks, kata para analis, karena negara-negara anggota sering kali memiliki pandangan yang berbeda mengenai titik api geopolitik tertentu bahkan ketika mereka dapat menyetujui prinsip-prinsip umum.

segments.src: ## Limited but Notable Unity
segments.tr: ## Persatuan yang Terbatas namun Patut Dicatat

segments.src: Foreign policy watchers cautioned against reading too much into the joint declaration's real-world impact.
segments.tr: Para pengamat kebijakan luar negeri memperingatkan agar tidak terlalu melebih-lebihkan dampak dunia nyata dari deklarasi bersama tersebut.

segments.src: BRICS communiqués are consensus documents without enforcement mechanisms, and individual members retain sharply different bilateral relationships with Washington, ranging from strategic partnership to open friction.
segments.tr: Komunike BRICS adalah dokumen konsensus tanpa mekanisme penegakan hukum, dan masing-masing anggota mempertahankan hubungan bilateral yang sangat berbeda dengan Washington, mulai dari kemitraan strategis hingga gesekan terbuka.

segments.src: Still, the fact that all attending leaders signed on to shared language on both the Middle East and trade was described by several delegations as a meaningful signal of the bloc's cohesion heading into a period of heightened global economic uncertainty.
segments.tr: Namun, fakta bahwa semua pemimpin yang hadir menandatangani bahasa bersama mengenai Timur Tengah dan perdagangan digambarkan oleh beberapa delegasi sebagai sinyal bermakna dari kohesi blok tersebut menjelang periode ketidakpastian ekonomi global yang meningkat.

segments.src: Discussions on the summit sidelines reportedly touched on expanding use of local currencies in trade settlement among member states, continued development financing through the New Development Bank, and coordination ahead of upcoming G20 and United Nations gatherings.
segments.tr: Diskusi di sela-sela KTT dilaporkan menyentuh perluasan penggunaan mata uang lokal dalam penyelesaian perdagangan di antara negara-negara anggota, kelanjutan pembiayaan pembangunan melalui New Development Bank, dan koordinasi menjelang pertemuan G20 dan Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa mendatang.

segments.src: No binding agreements on tariffs or sanctions were announced.
segments.tr: Tidak ada perjanjian mengikat mengenai tarif atau sanksi yang diumumkan.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa Selanjutnya

segments.src: Attention now turns to how individual capitals translate the New Delhi declaration into policy.
segments.tr: Perhatian sekarang beralih ke bagaimana masing-masing ibu kota menerjemahkan deklarasi New Delhi ke dalam kebijakan.

segments.src: Trade officials in several member states are expected to hold follow-up talks in the coming weeks, while diplomats said further statements on the Middle East situation would depend on how the security situation evolves.
segments.tr: Para pejabat perdagangan di beberapa negara anggota diharapkan mengadakan pembicaraan tindak lanjut dalam beberapa minggu mendatang, sementara para diplomat mengatakan pernyataan lebih lanjut mengenai situasi Timur Tengah akan bergantung pada bagaimana situasi keamanan berkembang.

segments.src: The next BRICS summit is expected to be hosted by another member state under the bloc's rotating chairmanship, continuing a pattern of annual meetings that have become a fixture of the global diplomatic calendar.
segments.tr: KTT BRICS berikutnya diharapkan akan diselenggarakan oleh negara anggota lain di bawah kepemimpinan bergilir blok tersebut, melanjutkan pola pertemuan tahunan yang telah menjadi agenda tetap kalender diplomatik global.

segments.src: For now, the New Delhi summit stands as an illustration of BRICS' evolving role: less a unified bloc with a single foreign policy than a forum where major and emerging economies attempt to find common ground on trade fairness and regional stability, even as their individual interests and alliances continue to diverge.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, KTT New Delhi berdiri sebagai ilustrasi peran BRICS yang terus berkembang: kurang sebagai blok terpadu dengan kebijakan luar negeri tunggal daripada forum di mana ekonomi besar dan berkembang mencoba menemukan titik temu mengenai keadilan perdagangan dan stabilitas regional, bahkan ketika kepentingan dan aliansi individu mereka terus berbeda.

ja.title: BRICS首脳がニューデリーに集結、関税緊張の中で中東の自制と自由貿易を呼びかけ

segments.src: Leaders of the BRICS bloc convened in New Delhi this week for the group's 18th annual summit, with host Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin and counterparts from across the expanding coalition.
segments.tr: BRICS諸国の首脳は今週、第18回年次サミットのためにニューデリーに集結した。議長国であるナレンドラ・モディ首相は、中国の習近平国家主席、ロシアのウラジーミル・プーチン大統領、そして拡大を続ける連合の各国首脳を歓迎した。

segments.src: The gathering produced a joint declaration urging restraint amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East and calling for global trade to remain "open and unimpeded" — language widely read as a response to recent tariff measures out of Washington.
segments.tr: この会合では、中東での緊張が高まる中での自制を促し、世界貿易が「開かれ、妨げられない」状態を維持することを求める共同宣言が発表された。この文言は、ワシントンによる最近の関税措置への対応として広く解釈されている。

segments.src: ## A Joint Message on Trade and Security
segments.tr: ## 貿易と安全保障に関する共同メッセージ

segments.src: According to the declaration issued at the close of the summit, member states expressed concern over the humanitarian toll of conflicts in the Middle East and called on all parties to prioritize dialogue over escalation.
segments.tr: サミット閉幕時に発表された宣言によると、加盟国は中東紛争による人道的被害に懸念を表明し、すべての当事者に対し、エスカレーションよりも対話を優先するよう求めた。

segments.src: The statement did not single out any one country or faction, instead framing the appeal in broad terms consistent with previous BRICS communiqués on regional conflicts.
segments.tr: 声明では特定の国や派閥を名指しすることはせず、地域紛争に関するこれまでのBRICS共同声明と一貫した広範な表現で訴えをまとめた。

segments.src: On trade, the bloc reiterated long-standing objections to unilateral tariff actions and non-tariff barriers, arguing that such measures disrupt supply chains and disproportionately affect developing economies.
segments.tr: 貿易に関しては、同ブロックは一方的な関税措置や非関税障壁に対する長年の反対を改めて表明し、こうした措置はサプライチェーンを混乱させ、発展途上国に不釣り合いな影響を与えると主張した。

segments.src: While the declaration avoided naming the United States directly, the timing and phrasing closely track months of friction between Washington and several BRICS members over import duties and industrial policy.
segments.tr: 宣言では米国を直接名指しすることは避けたものの、そのタイミングと表現は、輸入関税や産業政策をめぐってワシントンと複数のBRICS加盟国との間で数ヶ月間続いている摩擦を色濃く反映している。

segments.src: ## Why New Delhi, Why Now
segments.tr: ## なぜニューデリーなのか、なぜ今なのか

segments.src: India's turn as summit host carries symbolic weight.
segments.tr: インドがサミットの議長国を務めることには象徴的な重みがある。

segments.src: New Delhi has sought to position itself as a bridge-builder within BRICS — maintaining close economic ties with Western partners while also deepening cooperation with Russia and China through the bloc.
segments.tr: ニューデリーは、BRICS内での橋渡し役としての地位を確立しようと努めてきた。西側のパートナーと緊密な経済関係を維持しつつ、同ブロックを通じてロシアや中国との協力関係も深めている。

segments.src: Officials familiar with the discussions said Modi used his position as chair to steer the group toward consensus language rather than more pointed criticism favored by some members, a balancing act that has defined India's BRICS diplomacy in recent years.
segments.tr: 議論に詳しい関係者によると、モディ首相は議長としての立場を利用し、一部の加盟国が好むような鋭い批判ではなく、合意形成に向けた文言へとグループを誘導した。このバランス感覚こそが、近年のインドのBRICS外交を特徴づけている。

segments.src: The summit also comes as BRICS continues to grow beyond its founding five members — Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa — having added several new participants in recent expansion rounds.
segments.tr: 今回のサミットは、BRICSがブラジル、ロシア、インド、中国、南アフリカという創設メンバーを超えて成長を続け、最近の拡大ラウンドで新たな参加国をいくつか加えた中で開催された。

segments.src: That growth has made reaching unified statements more complex, analysts say, since member states often hold divergent views on specific geopolitical flashpoints even when they can agree on general principles.
segments.tr: アナリストによれば、加盟国は一般的な原則では合意できても、特定の地政学的な火種については意見が分かれることが多いため、こうした成長により統一された声明を出すことはより複雑になっているという。

segments.src: ## Limited but Notable Unity
segments.tr: ## 限定的だが注目すべき結束

segments.src: Foreign policy watchers cautioned against reading too much into the joint declaration's real-world impact.
segments.tr: 外交政策の専門家らは、共同宣言が現実世界に与える影響を過大評価しないよう警告した。

segments.src: BRICS communiqués are consensus documents without enforcement mechanisms, and individual members retain sharply different bilateral relationships with Washington, ranging from strategic partnership to open friction.
segments.tr: BRICSの共同声明は強制力のない合意文書であり、個々の加盟国はワシントンとの間で、戦略的パートナーシップから公然たる摩擦まで、極めて異なる二国間関係を維持している。

segments.src: Still, the fact that all attending leaders signed on to shared language on both the Middle East and trade was described by several delegations as a meaningful signal of the bloc's cohesion heading into a period of heightened global economic uncertainty.
segments.tr: それでも、出席したすべての首脳が中東と貿易の両方に関する共通の文言に署名したという事実は、世界的な経済不確実性が高まる時期に向かう中での同ブロックの結束を示す有意義なシグナルであると、複数の代表団が評価した。

segments.src: Discussions on the summit sidelines reportedly touched on expanding use of local currencies in trade settlement among member states, continued development financing through the New Development Bank, and coordination ahead of upcoming G20 and United Nations gatherings.
segments.tr: サミットのサイドラインで行われた議論では、加盟国間での貿易決済における現地通貨利用の拡大、新開発銀行を通じた継続的な開発融資、そして今後のG20や国連会合に向けた調整などが取り上げられたと報じられている。

segments.src: No binding agreements on tariffs or sanctions were announced.
segments.tr: 関税や制裁に関する拘束力のある合意は発表されなかった。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の展望

segments.src: Attention now turns to how individual capitals translate the New Delhi declaration into policy.
segments.tr: 今後は、各国の首都がニューデリー宣言をどのように政策に反映させるかに注目が集まる。

segments.src: Trade officials in several member states are expected to hold follow-up talks in the coming weeks, while diplomats said further statements on the Middle East situation would depend on how the security situation evolves.
segments.tr: 複数の加盟国の貿易担当者は今後数週間以内にフォローアップ協議を行う予定であり、外交官らは中東情勢に関するさらなる声明は安全保障状況の推移次第であると述べた。

segments.src: The next BRICS summit is expected to be hosted by another member state under the bloc's rotating chairmanship, continuing a pattern of annual meetings that have become a fixture of the global diplomatic calendar.
segments.tr: 次回のBRICSサミットは、同ブロックの持ち回り議長国制度に基づき、別の加盟国が主催する予定であり、世界の外交カレンダーの恒例行事となっている年次会合のパターンが継続されることになる。

segments.src: For now, the New Delhi summit stands as an illustration of BRICS' evolving role: less a unified bloc with a single foreign policy than a forum where major and emerging economies attempt to find common ground on trade fairness and regional stability, even as their individual interests and alliances continue to diverge.
segments.tr: 現時点では、ニューデリー・サミットはBRICSの進化する役割を象徴するものとなっている。それは単一の外交政策を持つ統一されたブロックというよりも、主要経済国や新興経済国が、それぞれの利益や同盟関係が分かれ続けている中でも、貿易の公平性と地域の安定について共通の基盤を見出そうとするフォーラムである。

de.title: BRICS-Staats- und Regierungschefs versammeln sich in Neu-Delhi, fordern Zurückhaltung im Nahen Osten und offenen Handel inmitten von Zollspannungen

segments.src: Leaders of the BRICS bloc convened in New Delhi this week for the group's 18th annual summit, with host Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin and counterparts from across the expanding coalition.
segments.tr: Die Staats- und Regierungschefs der BRICS-Staaten kamen diese Woche in Neu-Delhi zum 18. jährlichen Gipfeltreffen der Gruppe zusammen, wobei Gastgeber Premierminister Narendra Modi den chinesischen Präsidenten Xi Jinping, den russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin und Amtskollegen aus der gesamten expandierenden Koalition begrüßte.

segments.src: The gathering produced a joint declaration urging restraint amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East and calling for global trade to remain "open and unimpeded" — language widely read as a response to recent tariff measures out of Washington.
segments.tr: Das Treffen brachte eine gemeinsame Erklärung hervor, die zur Zurückhaltung angesichts der anhaltenden Spannungen im Nahen Osten aufforderte und verlangte, dass der Welthandel "offen und ungehindert" bleiben müsse — eine Formulierung, die weithin als Reaktion auf jüngste Zollmaßnahmen aus Washington verstanden wurde.

segments.src: ## A Joint Message on Trade and Security
segments.tr: ## Eine gemeinsame Botschaft zu Handel und Sicherheit

segments.src: According to the declaration issued at the close of the summit, member states expressed concern over the humanitarian toll of conflicts in the Middle East and called on all parties to prioritize dialogue over escalation.
segments.tr: Der am Ende des Gipfels veröffentlichten Erklärung zufolge äußerten die Mitgliedstaaten Besorgnis über die humanitären Opfer von Konflikten im Nahen Osten und forderten alle Parteien auf, den Dialog der Eskalation vorzuziehen.

segments.src: The statement did not single out any one country or faction, instead framing the appeal in broad terms consistent with previous BRICS communiqués on regional conflicts.
segments.tr: Die Erklärung nannte kein einzelnes Land und keine bestimmte Fraktion beim Namen, sondern fasste den Appell stattdessen in allgemeine Begriffe, die früheren BRICS-Kommuniqués zu regionalen Konflikten entsprachen.

segments.src: On trade, the bloc reiterated long-standing objections to unilateral tariff actions and non-tariff barriers, arguing that such measures disrupt supply chains and disproportionately affect developing economies.
segments.tr: In Bezug auf den Handel bekräftigte der Block seine langjährigen Einwände gegen unilaterale Zollmaßnahmen und nicht-tarifäre Handelshemmnisse und argumentierte, dass solche Maßnahmen Lieferketten stören und Entwicklungsländer unverhältnismäßig stark treffen.

segments.src: While the declaration avoided naming the United States directly, the timing and phrasing closely track months of friction between Washington and several BRICS members over import duties and industrial policy.
segments.tr: Obwohl die Erklärung vermied, die Vereinigten Staaten direkt zu nennen, stimmen das Timing und die Wortwahl eng mit monatelangen Reibereien zwischen Washington und mehreren BRICS-Mitgliedern über Einfuhrzölle und Industriepolitik überein.

segments.src: ## Why New Delhi, Why Now
segments.tr: ## Warum Neu-Delhi, warum jetzt

segments.src: India's turn as summit host carries symbolic weight.
segments.tr: Indiens Rolle als Gipfelgeber hat symbolisches Gewicht.

segments.src: New Delhi has sought to position itself as a bridge-builder within BRICS — maintaining close economic ties with Western partners while also deepening cooperation with Russia and China through the bloc.
segments.tr: Neu-Delhi hat versucht, sich als Brückenbauer innerhalb der BRICS zu positionieren – es pflegt enge wirtschaftliche Bindungen zu westlichen Partnern und vertieft gleichzeitig die Zusammenarbeit mit Russland und China durch den Block.

segments.src: Officials familiar with the discussions said Modi used his position as chair to steer the group toward consensus language rather than more pointed criticism favored by some members, a balancing act that has defined India's BRICS diplomacy in recent years.
segments.tr: Mit den Diskussionen vertraute Beamte sagten, Modi habe seine Position als Vorsitzender genutzt, um die Gruppe zu einer Konsensformulierung zu lenken, anstatt zu spitzeren Kritiken, die von einigen Mitgliedern bevorzugt wurden; ein Spagat, der Indiens BRICS-Diplomatie in den letzten Jahren geprägt hat.

segments.src: The summit also comes as BRICS continues to grow beyond its founding five members — Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa — having added several new participants in recent expansion rounds.
segments.tr: Der Gipfel findet auch zu einer Zeit statt, in der die BRICS weiter über ihre fünf Gründungsmitglieder – Brasilien, Russland, Indien, China und Südafrika – hinauswachsen, nachdem in den letzten Runden mehrere neue Teilnehmer hinzugekommen sind.

segments.src: That growth has made reaching unified statements more complex, analysts say, since member states often hold divergent views on specific geopolitical flashpoints even when they can agree on general principles.
segments.tr: Dieses Wachstum habe das Erreichen einheitlicher Erklärungen komplexer gemacht, so Analysten, da die Mitgliedstaaten oft unterschiedliche Ansichten zu bestimmten geopolitischen Konfliktherden vertreten, selbst wenn sie sich auf allgemeine Prinzipien einigen können.

segments.src: ## Limited but Notable Unity
segments.tr: ## Begrenzte, aber bemerkenswerte Einigkeit

segments.src: Foreign policy watchers cautioned against reading too much into the joint declaration's real-world impact.
segments.tr: Außenpolitische Beobachter warnten davor, zu viel in die realen Auswirkungen der gemeinsamen Erklärung hineinzuinterpretieren.

segments.src: BRICS communiqués are consensus documents without enforcement mechanisms, and individual members retain sharply different bilateral relationships with Washington, ranging from strategic partnership to open friction.
segments.tr: BRICS-Kommuniqués sind Konsensdokumente ohne Durchsetzungsmechanismen, und einzelne Mitglieder unterhalten stark unterschiedliche bilaterale Beziehungen zu Washington, die von strategischer Partnerschaft bis hin zu offenem Konflikt reichen.

segments.src: Still, the fact that all attending leaders signed on to shared language on both the Middle East and trade was described by several delegations as a meaningful signal of the bloc's cohesion heading into a period of heightened global economic uncertainty.
segments.tr: Dennoch wurde die Tatsache, dass alle anwesenden Staats- und Regierungschefs eine gemeinsame Formulierung sowohl zum Nahen Osten als auch zum Handel unterzeichneten, von mehreren Delegationen als bedeutsames Signal für den Zusammenhalt des Blocks zu Beginn einer Phase erhöhter globaler wirtschaftlicher Unsicherheit bezeichnet.

segments.src: Discussions on the summit sidelines reportedly touched on expanding use of local currencies in trade settlement among member states, continued development financing through the New Development Bank, and coordination ahead of upcoming G20 and United Nations gatherings.
segments.tr: Diskussionen am Rande des Gipfels berührten Berichten zufolge die Ausweitung der Verwendung lokaler Währungen bei der Handelsabwicklung zwischen den Mitgliedstaaten, die fortgesetzte Entwicklungsfinanzierung durch die Neue Entwicklungsbank und die Koordination im Vorfeld der kommenden G20- und VN-Gipfel.

segments.src: No binding agreements on tariffs or sanctions were announced.
segments.tr: Es wurden keine verbindlichen Abkommen über Zölle oder Sanktionen bekannt gegeben.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes kommt

segments.src: Attention now turns to how individual capitals translate the New Delhi declaration into policy.
segments.tr: Die Aufmerksamkeit richtet sich nun darauf, wie die einzelnen Hauptstädte die Erklärung von Neu-Delhi in die Praxis umsetzen.

segments.src: Trade officials in several member states are expected to hold follow-up talks in the coming weeks, while diplomats said further statements on the Middle East situation would depend on how the security situation evolves.
segments.tr: Handelsbeamte in mehreren Mitgliedstaaten werden voraussichtlich in den kommenden Wochen Folgetermine abhalten, während Diplomaten erklärten, weitere Erklärungen zur Lage im Nahen Osten würden davon abhängen, wie sich die Sicherheitslage entwickelt.

segments.src: The next BRICS summit is expected to be hosted by another member state under the bloc's rotating chairmanship, continuing a pattern of annual meetings that have become a fixture of the global diplomatic calendar.
segments.tr: Der nächste BRICS-Gipfel wird voraussichtlich von einem anderen Mitgliedstaat im Rahmen des rotierenden Vorsitzes des Blocks ausgerichtet werden, womit ein Muster jährlicher Treffen fortgesetzt wird, die zu einem festen Bestandteil des globalen diplomatischen Kalenders geworden sind.

segments.src: For now, the New Delhi summit stands as an illustration of BRICS' evolving role: less a unified bloc with a single foreign policy than a forum where major and emerging economies attempt to find common ground on trade fairness and regional stability, even as their individual interests and alliances continue to diverge.
segments.tr: Vorerst steht der Gipfel von Neu-Delhi als Illustration der sich entwickelnden Rolle der BRICS: weniger ein geschlossener Block mit einer einzigen Außenpolitik als vielmehr ein Forum, in dem große und aufstrebende Volkswirtschaften versuchen, eine gemeinsame Basis in Fragen der Handelsgerechtigkeit und regionalen Stabilität zu finden, auch wenn ihre individuellen Interessen und Allianzen weiterhin auseinandergehen.

vi.title: Các Lãnh Đạo BRICS Nhóm Họp Tại New Delhi, Kêu Gọi Kiềm Chế Ở Trung Đông và Thương Mại Mở Trong Bối Cảnh Căng Thẳng Thắt Thắt Thuế Quan

segments.src: Leaders of the BRICS bloc convened in New Delhi this week for the group's 18th annual summit, with host Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin and counterparts from across the expanding coalition.
segments.tr: Các lãnh đạo của khối BRICS đã nhóm họp tại New Delhi tuần này cho hội nghị thượng đỉnh thường niên lần thứ 18 của nhóm, với Thủ tướng nước chủ nhà Narendra Modi chào đón Chủ tịch Trung Quốc Tập Cận Bình, Tổng thống Nga Vladimir Putin và các đồng cấp từ khắp liên minh đang mở rộng.

segments.src: The gathering produced a joint declaration urging restraint amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East and calling for global trade to remain "open and unimpeded" — language widely read as a response to recent tariff measures out of Washington.
segments.tr: Cuộc gặp đã đưa ra một tuyên bố chung kêu gọi kiềm chế trong bối cảnh căng thẳng đang diễn ra ở Trung Đông và kêu gọi thương mại toàn cầu duy trì "mở và không bị cản trở" — ngôn từ được hiểu rộng rãi là sự đáp trả đối với các biện pháp thuế quan gần đây từ Washington.

segments.src: ## A Joint Message on Trade and Security
segments.tr: ## Thông Điệp Chung Về Thương Mại Và An Ninh

segments.src: According to the declaration issued at the close of the summit, member states expressed concern over the humanitarian toll of conflicts in the Middle East and called on all parties to prioritize dialogue over escalation.
segments.tr: Theo tuyên bố được đưa ra vào cuối hội nghị thượng đỉnh, các quốc gia thành viên bày tỏ sự quan ngại về tổn thất nhân đạo của các xung đột ở Trung Đông và kêu gọi tất cả các bên ưu tiên đối thoại hơn là leo thang.

segments.src: The statement did not single out any one country or faction, instead framing the appeal in broad terms consistent with previous BRICS communiqués on regional conflicts.
segments.tr: Tuyên bố không chỉ đích danh bất kỳ một quốc gia hay phe phái nào, thay vào đó định hình lời kêu gọi theo các điều khoản rộng rãi nhất quán với các thông cáo trước đây của BRICS về các xung đột khu vực.

segments.src: On trade, the bloc reiterated long-standing objections to unilateral tariff actions and non-tariff barriers, arguing that such measures disrupt supply chains and disproportionately affect developing economies.
segments.tr: Về thương mại, khối này nhắc lại những phản đối lâu nay đối với các hành động thuế quan đơn phương và các rào cản phi thuế quan, cho rằng các biện pháp như vậy làm gián đoạn chuỗi cung ứng và ảnh hưởng không đồng đều đến các nền kinh tế đang phát triển.

segments.src: While the declaration avoided naming the United States directly, the timing and phrasing closely track months of friction between Washington and several BRICS members over import duties and industrial policy.
segments.tr: Mặc dù tuyên bố tránh né việc nêu tên trực tiếp Hoa Kỳ, thời điểm và cách diễn đạt theo sát nhiều tháng ma sát giữa Washington và một số thành viên BRICS về thuế nhập khẩu và chính sách công nghiệp.

segments.src: ## Why New Delhi, Why Now
segments.tr: ## Tại Sao Lại Là New Delhi, Tại Sao Lại Là Bây Giờ

segments.src: India's turn as summit host carries symbolic weight.
segments.tr: Lượt Ấn Độ làm chủ nhà hội nghị thượng đỉnh mang tầm quan trọng biểu tượng.

segments.src: New Delhi has sought to position itself as a bridge-builder within BRICS — maintaining close economic ties with Western partners while also deepening cooperation with Russia and China through the bloc.
segments.tr: New Delhi đã cố gắng tự định vị mình như một người xây cầu nối trong BRICS — duy trì quan hệ kinh tế chặt chẽ với các đối tác phương Tây trong khi cũng tăng cường hợp tác với Nga và Trung Quốc thông qua khối.

segments.src: Officials familiar with the discussions said Modi used his position as chair to steer the group toward consensus language rather than more pointed criticism favored by some members, a balancing act that has defined India's BRICS diplomacy in recent years.
segments.tr: Các quan chức quen thuộc với các cuộc thảo luận cho biết Modi đã sử dụng vị trí chủ tọa của mình để hướng nhóm tới ngôn từ đồng thuận thay vì những lời chỉ trích gay gắt hơn được một số thành viên ủng hộ, một hành động cân bằng đã định hình ngoại giao BRICS của Ấn Độ trong những năm gần đây.

segments.src: The summit also comes as BRICS continues to grow beyond its founding five members — Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa — having added several new participants in recent expansion rounds.
segments.tr: Hội nghị thượng đỉnh cũng diễn ra khi BRICS tiếp tục phát triển vượt ra ngoài năm thành viên sáng lập ban đầu — Brazil, Nga, Ấn Độ, Trung Quốc và Nam Phi — sau khi đã thêm một số thành viên mới tham gia trong các vòng mở rộng gần đây.

segments.src: That growth has made reaching unified statements more complex, analysts say, since member states often hold divergent views on specific geopolitical flashpoints even when they can agree on general principles.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích cho biết, sự phát triển đó đã khiến việc đạt được các tuyên bố thống nhất trở nên phức tạp hơn, vì các quốc gia thành viên thường có quan điểm khác nhau về các điểm nóng địa chính trị cụ thể ngay cả khi họ có thể đồng ý về các nguyên tắc chung.

segments.src: ## Limited but Notable Unity
segments.tr: ## Sự Thống Nhất Hạn Chế Nhưng Đáng Chú Ý

segments.src: Foreign policy watchers cautioned against reading too much into the joint declaration's real-world impact.
segments.tr: Các nhà quan sát chính sách đối ngoại cảnh báo không nên đánh giá quá cao tác động thực tế của tuyên bố chung.

segments.src: BRICS communiqués are consensus documents without enforcement mechanisms, and individual members retain sharply different bilateral relationships with Washington, ranging from strategic partnership to open friction.
segments.tr: Các thông cáo của BRICS là các văn bản đồng thuận không có cơ chế cưỡng chế thực thi, và từng thành viên riêng lẻ vẫn duy trì các mối quan hệ song phương rất khác nhau với Washington, từ đối tác chiến lược đến ma sát công khai.

segments.src: Still, the fact that all attending leaders signed on to shared language on both the Middle East and trade was described by several delegations as a meaningful signal of the bloc's cohesion heading into a period of heightened global economic uncertainty.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, việc tất cả các lãnh đạo tham dự đều ký vào ngôn từ chung về cả Trung Đông và thương mại đã được một số phái đoàn mô tả là một tín hiệu có ý nghĩa về sự gắn kết của khối bước vào một giai đoạn gia tăng bất ổn kinh tế toàn cầu.

segments.src: Discussions on the summit sidelines reportedly touched on expanding use of local currencies in trade settlement among member states, continued development financing through the New Development Bank, and coordination ahead of upcoming G20 and United Nations gatherings.
segments.tr: Các cuộc thảo luận bên lề hội nghị thượng đỉnh đưa tin đã đề cập đến việc mở rộng sử dụng đồng nội tệ trong thanh toán thương mại giữa các quốc gia thành viên, tiếp tục tài trợ phát triển thông qua Ngân hàng Phát triển Mới (New Development Bank), và phối hợp trước các cuộc họp G20 và Liên Hợp Quốc sắp tới.

segments.src: No binding agreements on tariffs or sanctions were announced.
segments.tr: Không có thỏa thuận ràng buộc nào về thuế quan hoặc các biện pháp trừng phạt được công bố.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Điều Gì Sẽ Xảy Ra Tiếp Theo

segments.src: Attention now turns to how individual capitals translate the New Delhi declaration into policy.
segments.tr: Sự chú ý giờ đây chuyển sang cách chính quyền từng nước chuyển hóa tuyên bố New Delhi thành chính sách.

segments.src: Trade officials in several member states are expected to hold follow-up talks in the coming weeks, while diplomats said further statements on the Middle East situation would depend on how the security situation evolves.
segments.tr: Các quan chức thương mại ở một số quốc gia thành viên dự kiến sẽ tiến hành các cuộc đàm phán tiếp theo trong những tuần tới, trong khi các nhà ngoại giao cho biết các tuyên bố tiếp theo về tình hình Trung Đông sẽ phụ thuộc vào cách diễn biến của tình hình an ninh.

segments.src: The next BRICS summit is expected to be hosted by another member state under the bloc's rotating chairmanship, continuing a pattern of annual meetings that have become a fixture of the global diplomatic calendar.
segments.tr: Hội nghị thượng đỉnh BRICS tiếp theo dự kiến sẽ do một quốc gia thành viên khác làm chủ nhà theo luân phiên chủ tịch của khối, tiếp tục mô hình các cuộc họp thường niên đã trở thành một sự kiện cố định trong lịch trình ngoại giao toàn cầu.

segments.src: For now, the New Delhi summit stands as an illustration of BRICS' evolving role: less a unified bloc with a single foreign policy than a forum where major and emerging economies attempt to find common ground on trade fairness and regional stability, even as their individual interests and alliances continue to diverge.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, hội nghị thượng đỉnh New Delhi đứng như một minh chứng cho vai trò đang phát triển của BRICS: ít hơn là một khối thống nhất với một chính sách đối ngoại duy nhất, mà giống như một diễn đàn nơi các nền kinh tế lớn và mới nổi cố gắng tìm tiếng nói chung về sự công bằng thương mại và ổn định khu vực, ngay cả khi lợi ích và các liên minh riêng lẻ của họ tiếp tục phân hóa.
